why: The check that makes composition safe, asked in advance. A node reference alone rots invisibly — the node keeps its name while its content is rewritten and the citation still resolves — so the span is the whole of the evidence across a boundary that carries no sangha, no elector register and no resolution history. Here the node resolves and the quoted words are not in it: `external-citation-span-drift` and NOT `external-citation-unresolved`, because the two have different repairs and a caller told the wrong one goes looking for a node that is right where it always was.
